text: ok yeah glad i asked then now about that decimate and carry paint approach, yes, lets get that feature in now since it will save us so much time in the long run
resolution: Built paint-carries-through-decimation: paint is resolution-independent now. The authoritative per-face paint lives at full-res (g_source_colors); every quality level is a projection of it, so lowering quality keeps the paint and any baked LoD inherits it. mesh_import.decimateExpanded returns face_to_source[] (each decimated face -> its source face; unit-tested); painting any displayed face writes back to the source via the current map (writeSourceColor, in both paint_at and paint_face); __model_set_quality re-decimates and derives the new mesh's colours from the source through the new map (applyPaintColors/applyColors), storing the map; paintAt returns the hit face for write-back; DEFAULT_FACE exported. Proven: rainbow-paint the tree at 4,612 tris then decimate to 384 keeps the colours (shots/modelview_carry.png). Limitation: painting at LOW quality only writes the representative source face per cluster (sparse when raised); paint-at-detail-then-drop carries fully. Committed 1408b9ec5.
